verses.text: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.
lines: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High
will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.

verses.text: I will say of Yahweh, “He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust.”
lines: I will say of Yahweh, “He is my refuge and my fortress;
my God, in whom I trust.”

verses.text: For he will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly pestilence.
lines: For he will deliver you from the snare of the fowler,
and from the deadly pestilence.

verses.text: He will cover you with his feathers. Under his wings you will take refuge. His faithfulness is your shield and rampart.
lines: He will cover you with his feathers.
Under his wings you will take refuge.
His faithfulness is your shield and rampart.

verses.text: You shall not be afraid of the terror by night, nor of the arrow that flies by day,
lines: You shall not be afraid of the terror by night,
nor of the arrow that flies by day,

verses.text: nor of the pestilence that walks in darkness, nor of the destruction that wastes at noonday.
lines: nor of the pestilence that walks in darkness,
nor of the destruction that wastes at noonday.

verses.text: A thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; but it will not come near you.
lines: A thousand may fall at your side,
and ten thousand at your right hand;
but it will not come near you.

verses.text: You will only look with your eyes, and see the recompense of the wicked.
lines: You will only look with your eyes,
and see the recompense of the wicked.

verses.text: Because you have made Yahweh your refuge, and the Most High your dwelling place,
lines: Because you have made Yahweh your refuge,
and the Most High your dwelling place,

verses.text: no evil shall happen to you, neither shall any plague come near your dwelling.
lines: no evil shall happen to you,
neither shall any plague come near your dwelling.

verses.text: For he will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you in all your ways.
lines: For he will put his angels in charge of you,
to guard you in all your ways.

verses.text: They will bear you up in their hands, so that you won’t dash your foot against a stone.
lines: They will bear you up in their hands,
so that you won’t dash your foot against a stone.

verses.text: You will tread on the lion and cobra. You will trample the young lion and the serpent underfoot.
lines: You will tread on the lion and cobra.
You will trample the young lion and the serpent underfoot.

verses.text: “Because he has set his love on me, therefore I will deliver him. I will set him on high, because he has known my name.
lines: “Because he has set his love on me, therefore I will deliver him.
I will set him on high, because he has known my name.

verses.text: He will call on me, and I will answer him. I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him, and honor him.
lines: He will call on me, and I will answer him.
I will be with him in trouble.
I will deliver him, and honor him.

verses.text: I will satisfy him with long life, and show him my salvation.”
lines: I will satisfy him with long life,
and show him my salvation.”
